'''Testarr sector''' was in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Sestria]]. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Yarr Gatonne]] was known to work in the Testarr sector.
